MADNESS.Notify.PlaceholderTablesCreated: Tasha's Madness Tracker created placeholder Short-Term/Long-Term/Indefinite Madness roll tables in a 'Madness Tracker' folder. Edit them to add your rulebook's table entries.
MADNESS.Notify.NoTableConfigured: No {type} madness table is configured (see module settings).
MADNESS.Notify.RollManually: Couldn't roll automatically - roll on your character sheet and enter the total manually.
MADNESS.Notify.RecoveryFail: {name} failed their recovery check ({total} vs DC {dc}). The affliction continues.
MADNESS.Notify.RestRecoveryReminder: {name} is still afflicted by madness - consider an end-of-rest recovery check.
MADNESS.Chat.Expired: {name}'s {label} has run its course and ended.
MADNESS.Chat.NoResultText: (no result text - edit the table entry)
MADNESS.CheckApp.Title: Madness Check
MADNESS.CheckApp.ModeHint: Saving Throw mode asks each target to roll; on a failure, the table below becomes available. Direct mode skips the save and rolls the table immediately (e.g. for a cursed item or spell effect).
MADNESS.CheckApp.FlavorPlaceholder: You witness an act of unspeakable horror...
MADNESS.CheckApp.MadnessTypeHint: Which table applies on a failed save (or is rolled directly).
MADNESS.TrackerApp.Title: Madness Tracker
MADNESS.Settings.DefaultDC.Name: Default Save DC
MADNESS.Settings.DefaultDC.Hint: Default DC pre-filled in the Madness Check dialog.
MADNESS.Settings.DefaultAbility.Name: Default Saving Throw Ability
MADNESS.Settings.DefaultAbility.Hint: Default ability pre-filled in the Madness Check dialog (usually Wisdom).
MADNESS.Settings.ShortTable.Name: Short-Term Madness Table
MADNESS.Settings.ShortTable.Hint: UUID of the RollTable used for Short-Term Madness. A placeholder table is created automatically; paste a different table's UUID here to use your own instead.
MADNESS.Settings.LongTable.Name: Long-Term Madness Table
MADNESS.Settings.LongTable.Hint: UUID of the RollTable used for Long-Term Madness.
MADNESS.Settings.IndefiniteTable.Name: Indefinite Madness Table
MADNESS.Settings.IndefiniteTable.Hint: UUID of the RollTable used for Indefinite Madness.
MADNESS.Settings.ShortDuration.Name: Short-Term Duration Formula (minutes)
MADNESS.Settings.ShortDuration.Hint: Roll formula for how many minutes a Short-Term Madness lasts, per your rulebook (default 1d10).
MADNESS.Settings.LongDuration.Name: Long-Term Duration Formula (hours)
MADNESS.Settings.LongDuration.Hint: Roll formula for how many hours a Long-Term Madness lasts, per your rulebook (default 1d10 x 10).
MADNESS.Settings.RecoveryDC.Name: Recovery Check DC
MADNESS.Settings.RecoveryDC.Hint: DC used by the tracker's 'Attempt Recovery' button (e.g. an end-of-rest Wisdom save to shake off Long-Term/Indefinite Madness). Adjust to match your rulebook.
MADNESS.Settings.PromptRecovery.Name: Remind Recovery Checks After Rest
MADNESS.Settings.PromptRecovery.Hint: When enabled, the GM gets a chat notification after any afflicted character finishes a rest, as a reminder to run a recovery check.
